summary: Build the HTTP transport adapter for the SOX Protocol Python reference implementation. Exposes all 16 v1 operations as JSON-over-HTTP POST endpoints under /v1/ops/<operation>, with a Server-Sent Events stream at GET /v1/stream for live recv push and channels__collect long-running responses. Identity is asserted via Authorization: Bearer <credential> resolved by the existing identity middleware. CORS allow-list is configurable. A GET /health probe returns store + transport liveness. The OpenAPI document at spec/transports/http/openapi.yaml is generated deterministically from spec/operations/*.json by tools/openapi_gen.py and committed. The conformance-suite runner targets this transport via --target http://host:port and uses the same SSE stream to observe asynchronous recv arrivals.

files.purpose: Public entrypoint; re-exports HttpTransport and create_app.
FastAPI application factory: registers operation routes, /health, /v1/stream SSE, and CORS middleware. Wires identity middleware into a starlette dependency.
public_api: create_app(store: BackingStore, identity: IdentityResolver, config: HttpConfig) -> FastAPI

files.purpose: One handler per operation: send, recv, subscribe, unsubscribe, list_channels, channels_ack, channels_heartbeat, channels_collect, replay, group_create, group_invite, group_join, group_leave, group_list_members. Each validates input against the matching JSON schema and returns the operation's output schema.

Server-Sent Events stream for live recv push and channels__collect progress. Multiplexes per-agent watch streams onto a single connection per identity. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID resume by seq cursor.
GET /health: returns {status, protocol_version, store_ok, uptime_s}. No auth required.
CORS middleware factory honouring SOX_HTTP_CORS_ORIGINS; defaults to http://localhost:* and http://127.0.0.1:*; never emits Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with credentials.
Bearer token extraction + identity middleware integration. Rejects with 401 + sox-error envelope on missing/invalid credential.
Pydantic config model loaded from env vars SOX_HTTP_HOST, SOX_HTTP_PORT, SOX_HTTP_CORS_ORIGINS, SOX_HTTP_BUFFER_LIMIT, SOX_HTTP_RECONNECT_MAX_S.
Maps internal exceptions to sox-error envelopes and HTTP status codes.
Adds `sox serve --transport http|stdio` subcommand. For http: instantiates HttpConfig, builds app via create_app, runs uvicorn.
argparse entrypoint dispatching to serve_command and existing subcommands.
Test package marker.
Pytest fixtures: in-memory backing store, test identity, async test client (httpx.AsyncClient + ASGITransport).

Per-operation request/response validation against operation schemas; covers all 16 operations including channels_ack tool semantics (no message-body ack), seq present on recv responses, dm/<sorted-pair> channel naming.
SSE stream tests: live recv push delivers seq monotonically; channels_collect emits progress + final; Last-Event-ID resume.
401 on missing/invalid bearer; 200 on valid; sender field is server-certified from identity, not request body.
Preflight handling; allow-list enforcement; never wildcard with credentials; localhost defaults.
GET /health returns 200 within 5s of startup, includes protocol_version.
CLI smoke: `sox serve --transport http --port <ephemeral>` starts and answers /health.
OpenAPI 3.1 document generated from operation schemas. Routes mirror /v1/ops/<operation> with input/output schema components, plus /v1/stream (SSE) and /health.
Documents wire format, SSE event shape, error envelope mapping, CORS configuration, and how to regenerate the OpenAPI document.
Reads spec/operations/*.{input,output}.schema.json and emits spec/transports/http/openapi.yaml. Deterministic ordering. Handles x-status: planned (marks operation deprecated/experimental).

wire_format.request_response: JSON over HTTP POST to /v1/ops/<operation>; request body is the operation's input schema; response body is the operation's output schema; sox-error envelope on error with 4xx/5xx.
wire_format.live_recv: Server-Sent Events at GET /v1/stream. Rationale: SSE is unidirectional server->client which matches recv push semantics; survives any HTTP/1.1 reverse proxy without WebSocket upgrades; trivial for the conformance runner to consume with httpx (line iteration); supports Last-Event-ID resume keyed on per-channel seq, aligning with the seq-on-every-message primitive. WebSocket was rejected because no client-to-server messages are needed on the stream (operations are POSTed) and SSE composes better with CORS preflight.
wire_format.auth: Authorization: Bearer <credential>; identity middleware resolves credential -> agent_id; agent_id is server-certified into envelope.sender.

openapi.generation: from spec/operations/*.json via tools/openapi_gen.py; regenerated on every build by `python3 tools/openapi_gen.py`; validated with openapi-spec-validator.

test_plan: Per-operation contract tests assert input/output validate against spec/operations schemas.
channels_ack covered as a tool call returning sox-ack envelope; assert no sox-ack body appears on subsequent recv of the channel.
DM tests use dm/<sorted-pair> channel naming; assert lexicographic sort of agent ids.
recv test asserts seq is present, integer >=1, monotone per channel.
channels_heartbeat updates server-side liveness; presence reflected on sox/presence channel.
replay since seq=N returns only messages with seq>=N.
channels_collect emits SSE progress events and final aggregate; honours timeout.
Identity: 401 on missing/invalid bearer; sender forgery in body is overridden by certified identity.
CORS preflight: OPTIONS with allowed Origin returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: <origin>; disallowed origin returns 403/no-cors-header.
Health: GET /health returns 200 within 5s of startup including protocol_version.
CLI smoke spawns uvicorn on ephemeral port and curls /health.
risks: SSE buffering by intermediate proxies could delay live recv events; mitigated by X-Accel-Buffering: no header and periodic keep-alive comments.

FastAPI dependency injection for identity must run before request body parsing to avoid leaking unauthenticated payloads to logs; mitigated by using a starlette middleware rather than a route dependency for the auth check.
OpenAPI generation must keep stable key ordering across runs; mitigated by sorted() at every level and a CI diff-check.
channels_collect long-poll vs SSE divergence: we standardize on SSE only; documented in spec/transports/http/README.md and reflected in conformance live_recv_strategy.
exit_signals: Conformance suite passes against HTTP target
